data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to enhance returns over a portfolio of debt instruments with a moderate exposurein equity and equity related instruments. By investing in debt securities, the Scheme will aim at generating regular returns,while enhancement of return is intended through investing in equity and equity related securities. The Scheme may also usevarious derivative and hedging products from time to time, in the manner permitted by SEBI. There is no assurance that theinvestment objective of the Schemes will be realised.
